# Applications {-}

<!-- SCAFFOLD: signposting only. Both chapters in this section are early-stage --
     fireSense_hindcast is a work in progress, and fireSense_summary's
     documentation predates several years of changes to its code. See #2. -->

The modules in this section support work around a fitted-and-predicted fireSense
model rather than forming part of the core workflow.

`fireSense_hindcast` runs fireSense over historic climate years, which allows a
parameterisation to be compared against a fire record it was not fitted to.
`fireSense_summary` collects the results of many fireSense simulations across
study areas, climate scenarios and replicates into a single set of summaries.
